review_candidates.title: Recruiting Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Why work at Higgsfield AI? Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like. What This Role Owns The Recruiting Coordinator owns process execution and accuracy . Recruiters own candidate assessment, relationship management, sourcing strategy, and closing. Hiring managers own hiring decisions. The Recruiting Coordinator makes sure the process connecting all of them runs efficiently. The Recruiting Coordinator is the operational backbone of the recruiting team, ensuring that candidates, recruiters, and hiring managers move through the hiring process quickly and smoothly. The goal is to remove administrative work from recruiters and hiring managers while creating a consistently strong candidate experience. What you’ll do Interview Coordination Schedule recruiter screens, hiring manager interviews, technical interviews, panels, and final rounds. Coordinate complex interview loops across multiple time zones and teams. Manage rescheduling and last-minute changes quickly. Ensure interviewers have the correct calendar invites, candidate materials, and interview instructions. Coordinate Zoom or in-person interview logistics. Candidate Experience Serve as an operational point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process. Send interview confirmations, preparation materials, follow-ups, and logistical information. Make sure candidates always know what happens next and are not left waiting for updates. Coordinate onsite interviews, including office access, rooms, meals, and travel when required. ATS & Recruiting Operations Keep Ashby candidate records, interview stages, sources, notes, and statuses accurate and up to date. Make sure candidates are moved through the correct stages and closed appropriately. Monitor missing scorecards and follow up with interviewers. Maintain clean recruiting data so dashboards and reports are reliable. Support job creation, interviewer setup, scheduling templates, and recruiting workflows in Ashby. Hiring Manager & Recruiter Support Partner closely with recruiters to manage active pipelines. Follow up with hiring managers and interviewers when feedback or scheduling availability is missing. Prepare recruiting materials and candidate information ahead of interviews. Ensure approvals and required information are collected before an offer is issued. Support the handoff of accepted candidates to HR / People Ops for onboarding. Recruiting Team Operations Help maintain recruiting trackers, documentation, templates, and internal resources. Support weekly recruiting meetings and pipeline reviews. Identify repetitive administrative work that can be standardized or automated. Requirements Highly organized and exceptionally detail-oriented. Comfortable managing many simultaneous processes and calendar changes. Strong written communication skills in English and Russian. Able to work with senior candidates and executives professionally. Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Experience with Ashby and Linkedin Recruiter. Experience coordinating interviews across multiple countries and time zones is a plus. What we offer Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role. Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth. Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country. A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company. Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales. Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits. This is a fully on-site role based in our Almaty office . Our team works from the office five days per week for the full working day . We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.

Proven leadership abilities to influence, develop, and empower team members to achieve goals through a collaborative approach. Experience leading a software company into new markets. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. review_candidates.title: Process Intelligence & Automation Engineer (Celonis)(m/f/d)
review_candidates.description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. Flix is reshaping how customers get help, moving towards AI-driven resolution across every channel, language, and market. As a Process Intelligence & Automation Engineer(m/f/d) , you turn that ambition into running systems: you design and deliver end-to-end automated processes on the Celonis platform that resolve real customer cases without human intervention, for millions of passengers. You bring engineering rigour into a business team. You translate business requirements into data models, pipelines, and automations fast, you own what you ship in production, and you are comfortable being the most technical person in the room. About The Role Data integration and modelling: identify the source-system tables and fields that need to be brought into Celonis; build and maintain the extractions, transformations (ETL) and Celonis data models for each Customer Service process, spanning ticketing, order management, and payment/refund data. Automation development: design, build, and operate production automations on the Celonis platform (Action Flows and Process Orchestrator) that execute real customer outcomes (e.g. end-to-end refund handling), including API calls into Flix backend systems and integrations with AI-driven customer contact channels (chatbot, voicebot). Reliability and guardrails: your automations move real money; build for scalability, error handling, monitoring, auditability, and safe rollout of changes. Insourcing and takeover: take over data models and automation logic built by an external implementation partner (reverse-engineer, document, harden, and extend them as the in-house owner). Collaboration: work daily with business users who own rules and business logic, the Data Analyst who owns dashboards and process mining, and IT engineering who own system integrations, security, and scalability. Documentation: document all technical and data requirements and all ETL and automation work to Centre of Excellence standards, so nothing you build depends on you being in the room. About You Automation platform experience: 3+ years hands-on building production automations on process orchestration or automation platforms; Celonis is a strong plus (Data Integration, PQL, Knowledge Models, Action Flows, Process Orchestrator); strong experience with platforms such as n8n, Camunda, UiPath, Power Automate, or Make is also relevant. We care about proven end-to-end delivery, not certifications. Production ownership at scale: you have owned and shipped solutions handling transactions at scale (1M+ annually) and can talk concretely about what broke and how you fixed it. Data fundamentals: working SQL and data modelling basics; you understand how to identify a correct case ID, control grain in joins, and validate a data model against its sources. Scripting (Python or similar) is a plus but not required (you are comfortable using AI tooling to fill gaps here). Enterprise systems and integration literacy: solid understanding of how core operational systems work — CRM, ticketing, order management, and ERP — including their data structures, process flows, and the business logic they enforce. Equally, you are fluent in how these systems integrate: REST and SOAP APIs, authentication mechanisms, webhooks, rate limits, and data exchange formats (JSON, XML). You can independently read API documentation, navigate integration patterns, and reason about data flow across system boundaries. Hybrid profile: you thrive in a roughly 70/30 technical-business role: you sit inside the business, gather requirements yourself, and can explain and defend technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders. Communication: clear written documentation and communication in English; you leave behind artefacts other people can pick up. Conversational automation experience: hands-on experience connecting automated workflows to chatbot or voicebot platforms is a plus. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! What We Offer Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career Why Join Flix? At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path. As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work. If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!
